title: Natural additive half-plane Postnikov abutment
statement: Let A and B be abelian categories, and suppose D(A) is a derived category with its standard t-structure. For any PostnikovPageData P, there exists PostnikovAbutmentData P: on the full half-plane subcategory, the normalized diagonal colimits, convergence, additive image-step and graded functors, limiting-page functor, and stable-page/graded comparisons obey all specified cocone, inclusion and quotient squares. The witness interfaces are defined in [def-per-postnikov-additive-witness-data].

source.place: Tags 012F and 012U: limiting page and image filtration under half-plane convergence; normalized diagonal colimits and naturality are the project formulation.

proof.text: Apply half-plane convergence objectwise with each object’s own cutoff, giving normalized diagonal colimits, limiting subobjects and convergence. Alpha commutation gives a unique map of diagonal colimits, identified at index zero with the prescribed D-map. Restrict to image filtration steps and descend to adjacent-step cokernels; mono/epi cancellation proves functor laws and additivity. Restrict initial E-maps to limiting cycles and descend modulo limiting boundaries. The canonical infinity-to-graded comparison is natural after the epimorphic canonical maps from D. Past both half-plane differential bounds, the stationary cycle and boundary quotient gives late-page comparisons; its defining projection proves their naturality and projection equations. Uses [thm-sp-half-plane-convergence], [lem-sp-derived-couple-functoriality], [def-sp-filtration], [def-sp-convergence].
